title: Scale: Rank
description: Use this oracle to randomly set the challenge rank of a quest, journey, or foe. Choose the column and roll.

data.quest: **Troublesome** — A challenging quest with a small number of obstacles
data.journey: **Troublesome** — Traveling a moderate distance within a single region

data.quest: **Dangerous** — An involved quest with several obstacles
data.journey: **Dangerous** — Traveling a long distance within a single region, or across rough terrain

data.quest: **Formidable** — A complex quest with many obstacles
data.journey: **Formidable** — Traveling from one region to another, or across especially challenging terrain

data.quest: **Extreme** — An intimidating quest with scores of obstacles
data.foe: **Extreme** — Foes of overwhelming skill or power

data.quest: **Epic** — A life-defining quest of unknowable scope
data.journey: **Epic** — Traveling from one end of the Ironlands to another, or to a separate land
